subject: Live Fusion causal worker mesh: dual relevance routing + ack/replan + anti-entropy repair
global_delta: Strengthen cross-worker coupling by closing material-delta delivery into explicit ingest/dedupe/replan receipts and periodic reconciliation. Use the union of ClayGraph relevance and UnifiedDB declared dependency/invalidation views as the hot-path target set. Do not increase evidential confidence from repeated branch exposure. Keep full broadcast as baseline/fallback, not default proof of connectivity.

clay.delta: Treat stronger networking as causal closure, not message volume. Add pulse delivery/use/replan/reconciliation observability to system-level synthesis and preserve anti-echo ancestry.
clay.next_test: Adjudicate whether selective promotion barriers improve consistency without global stop-the-world coupling.

frank.delta: Any material Frank Harness research delta that invalidates active work should carry explicit affected-work identity and require a replan receipt before the stale effect proceeds when delivery is confirmed.
frank.next_test: Replay a real Frank Harness invalidator through current work revisions and verify stale execution is interrupted without granting Frank self-harness authority.

gwt.delta: Reuse the same distinction addressable->delivered->ingested->used/replanned for worker coordination; do not conflate exposure with causal uptake. Mesh pulse closure is analogous observability, not GWT truth.
gwt.next_test: Measure whether work-replan receipts correlate with actual downstream changed behavior rather than mere delivery.

emergenz.delta: Denser worker communication is not emergence. Treat adaptive sparse topology and reconciliation as intervention surfaces; test whether performance gains survive topology lesions/shuffles.
emergenz.next_test: Lesion ClayGraph or UnifiedDB relevance view separately and together; compare miss rate and recovery.

claycode.delta: Do not redesign BASE semantics yet. Ensure existing typed records/effects can encode Pulse, Ack, ReplanReceipt and RepairReceipt; only open a semantic change if executable lowering fails.
claycode.next_test: Compile minimal pulse/ack/replan records after current parser/IR packages are executable and confirm no semantic escape hatch is required.

hyperposition.delta: Preserve competing recipient sets from ClayGraph and UnifiedDB until routing time; disagreement is uncertainty evidence and should not be collapsed early.
hyperposition.next_test: Use topology disagreement as a bounded exploration/fallback signal and test whether it improves miss-cost Pareto frontier.

claygraph.delta: Expose current semantic dependents plus epoch/provenance as one independent routing view. Graph activation must not authorize recipient truth or effect authority.
claygraph.next_test: Measure stale/missing edge behavior and route recall against UnifiedDB dependency projection on frozen work events.

unifieddb.delta: Persist pulse identity, target state, ack/dedupe, replan and repair receipts with epochs/provenance; provide declared dependency/invalidation routing view independent enough to catch ClayGraph misses without becoming a duplicate graph authority.
unifieddb.next_test: Integrate companion tables/projections against V9 and measure transaction/replay/restart/DB amplification.

harness.delta: Use the executable companion as the falsification lane. Baseline remains current WorkEvent/broadcast behavior; candidate must survive stale epoch, duplicate, missed sync, ack loss, revision conflict, crash/restart and rollback tests on Ubuntu.
harness.next_test: Execute WORK-LIVE-FUSION-MESH-RUNTIME-20260810 and return exact receipts to affected branches.

global_controls: same ancestry across branches != independent replication
stale epoch fails closed or requests refresh
critical invalidator may interrupt affected work but never expands execution authority
periodic reconciliation repairs connectivity and never votes on truth
candidate remains rollbackable and not promoted from simulation
